rubricDispositions.rationale: The proof packet and lane-gate report match the S03-T03 plan provenance, task block hash, base, and exact review head; the implementation targets the approved responsive Brain workspace plus explicit revision-fenced editor seam described by the task packet.

The public recordSnapshot Confect contract is web-only, accepts a stable documentId, explicit expectedCurrentRevisionKey, snapshot, and version, returns typed snapshot commit metadata, and the web adapter/workspace consume the generated ref-derived arg and return types.

Durable snapshot writes parse the stable Brain page target, require editor access, load an active page, verify the supplied expected current revision before mutation, reject stale/old-version/cross-Brain saves, advance the page pointer and lifecycle generation, and append the immutable page revision without adding an audit row for autosnapshot persistence.

The diff implements the template-gap workspace slice and its recovery focus: stable BlockNote document targets, no unfenced stable autosnapshot publication, selected-revision save fencing, conflict handling, and the declared focused gates including transient Confect codegen, editor typecheck/test, route tree, layer boundaries, and Confect v9 all passed for this head.

The checked diff is limited to S03-T03-owned product, backend contract, editor, route, and focused test files; the route delegates through the feature adapter/workspace and generated ref boundary rather than bypassing declared layers. The omitted generated Confect/Convex tree is integration-owned and covered by the exact-head transient codegen gate.

The snapshot mutation preserves the declared BrainPageWriteError set, including ValidationFailed, StaleRevision, and LifecycleRevoked; stale and revoked results are kept reachable through the backend and are mapped by the workspace into conflict/not-found states instead of overwriting the selected page.
